name: else if chain
template: ${{ if eq outputs.count 1 }}one${{ else if eq outputs.count 3 }}three${{ else }}other${{ end }}

name: else with
template: ${{ with outputs.empty }}a${{ else with outputs.list }}${{ index . 0 }}${{ end }}

name: range break
template: ${{ range outputs.nums }}${{ if eq . 2 }}${{ break }}${{ end }}${{ . }}${{ end }}

name: range continue
template: ${{ range outputs.nums }}${{ if eq . 2 }}${{ continue }}${{ end }}${{ . }}${{ end }}

name: nested range
template: ${{ range $a := outputs.list }}${{ range $b := outputs.nums }}${{ $a }}${{ $b }} ${{ end }}${{ end }}

name: len
template: ${{ len repository.name }} ${{ len steps.modified_files }} ${{ len outputs.obj }}

name: break in nested if in range
template: ${{ range outputs.nums }}${{ if gt . 1 }}${{ if lt . 3 }}${{ break }}${{ end }}${{ end }}${{ . }}${{ end }}

name: continue keeps going
template: ${{ range $i, $v := outputs.list }}${{ if eq $i 1 }}${{ continue }}${{ end }}${{ $v }}${{ end }}

name: else with nil
template: ${{ with outputs.nothing }}a${{ else with outputs.empty }}b${{ else }}c${{ end }}

name: eq bool
template: ${{ eq outputs.flag false }} ${{ eq true outputs.yes }}
